name: Clank – AI chat
description: AI chat with projects, templates, folders and repositories, and screenshots.
long_description: Works with the assistants connected in OmniWrench (Settings > AI assistants) and shares chats and projects with the chat panel. Every project gets its own workspace: local folders, Git repositories and online repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps – read online or cloned locally). Assistants can list, search and read the workspace, see Git status, log and diffs, propose file changes (shown as a diff) and run commands (shown with an explanation) – both only after confirmation, with an option to remember the answer for the session. What assistants may see is set on the page 'AI access' like for every tool; pseudonymization replaces addresses and names before sending. Files open in a viewer with highlighting and can be attached to the chat. Plus templates for recurring questions (with placeholders) and screenshots straight into the chat. Images, music, video, group chat, documents, schedules, transcription, voice assistant and MCP are separate AI tools (Pixelizer, Groovitron, Vidcomic, Q-Force, Infobot, Orvus, Kreeli, Mr. Zurkon, Gadgetron).
author: KuroShiro
